name: Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich
description: Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München is a public research university in Munich, founded in 1472. With about 52,000 students across the humanities, natural sciences, medicine and law it is one of Germany's largest universities.
whyIncluded: Its medical degree is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, and Germany is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 640 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for Munich: private room, food and transport for 12 months. Its food figure also covers health insurance and leisure. Excludes the semester fee.
livingCosts.notes: LMU International Student Guide 'Living costs' (budget about EUR 1,500 a month in Munich): housing = midpoint of 'rooms in private housing including utilities 700-1,000' (university housing is 400-600); food = 'food, health insurance, leisure activities approx. 500' (the page does not split these, so the figure includes health insurance and leisure); transport = Deutschlandticket for students EUR 43/month; personal 0 because the page lists no separate personal/books figure (leisure is inside the food line). Semester fee (97) excluded.

programmes.name: Rechtswissenschaft (Erste Juristische Prüfung / Staatsexamen)
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for non-EU students. The figure is only the student services contribution of EUR 97 per semester. The degree takes about five years.
programmes.notes: LMU charges no tuition fees (none since winter 2013/14, also for non-EU students). Compulsory fees = Studierendenwerk München Oberbayern basic fee EUR 97.00 per semester x2 (from summer semester 2026; the semester-ticket surcharge has been suspended since winter 2023/24, so no transport ticket is included). History: winter 2024/25 basic fee EUR 85.00 (LMU fee page); winter 2025/26 EUR 85.00 (Studierendenwerk basic-fee statute, 97 only from summer 2026). Undergraduate-entry state examination degree (Erste Juristische Prüfung), standard period 10 subject semesters per LMU's programme page (5427); the university part of the exam is taken from the 8th semester. Language of instruction: German. Winter intake only.

programmes.name: Medizin (Staatsexamen)
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for non-EU students. The figure is only the student services contribution of EUR 97 per semester, over about six years. Places are nationally restricted.
programmes.notes: LMU charges no tuition fees (none since winter 2013/14, also for non-EU students). Compulsory fees = Studierendenwerk München Oberbayern basic fee EUR 97.00 per semester x2 (from summer semester 2026; the semester-ticket surcharge has been suspended since winter 2023/24, so no transport ticket is included). History: winter 2024/25 basic fee EUR 85.00 (LMU fee page); winter 2025/26 EUR 85.00 (Studierendenwerk basic-fee statute, 97 only from summer 2026). Undergraduate-entry state examination degree: LMU lists 4 subject semesters for the first section (pre-clinical, taught jointly with TUM under MeCuM) and 8 for the second, i.e. 12 semesters; the federal licensing regulation puts the whole programme at 6 years and 3 months including the final exam. Admission is nationally restricted (hochschulstart). Language of instruction: German. Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (Medizinische Fakultät) is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications.

programmes.summary: No tuition, including for non-EU students. The figure is only the student services contribution of EUR 97 per semester. Taught in German and needs a psychology bachelor's.
programmes.notes: LMU charges no tuition fees (none since winter 2013/14, also for non-EU students). Compulsory fees = Studierendenwerk München Oberbayern basic fee EUR 97.00 per semester x2 (from summer semester 2026; the semester-ticket surcharge has been suspended since winter 2023/24, so no transport ticket is included). Same page and figures as LMU's existing programmes, whose history rows are copied. History: winter 2024/25 basic fee EUR 85.00 (LMU fee page); winter 2025/26 EUR 85.00 (Studierendenwerk basic-fee statute, 97 only from summer 2026). Programme: Psychologie: Wirtschafts-, Organisations- und Sozialpsychologie (Master/Hauptfach), https://www.lmu.de/de/studium/studienangebot/alle-studienfaecher-und-studiengaenge/psychologie-wirtschafts-organisations-und-sozialpsychologie-master-hauptfach-4548.html: M.Sc., 120 ECTS, 4 Fachsemester, winter start, Studiensprache Deutsch, local selection by the faculty. LMU has no general M.Sc. Psychologie; its four psychology master's are this one, Klinische Psychologie und Psychotherapie (German, licensure track), and the English-taught Psychology: Learning Sciences and Human Development and Neuro-Cognitive Psychology. This broad applied (work, organisational, social) programme was chosen; all four carry the same fees.
